note: Scope conditions taken from the acquired current eCFR text. Each condition quotes the scope provision it rests on; the engine verifies every quote against the index before using the condition. A condition routes a profile's entity category into or out of a part's stated scope only. It is not a legal determination: the listed qualifiers are never evaluated, applicability to a specific institution is not concluded, and a part outside one profile's stated scope does not mean no counterpart rule applies.
